articles.title: Whoa! This Artist Turns Plain Paper into Leaves, Feathers, and Bones
articles.summary: Marisa Aragón Ware makes incredibly detailed paper sculptures of nature. She cuts and scores paper to look just like real flowers, bird wings, and animal bones. Her art reminds us that even everyday stuff can become something amazing.

articles.title: MIT Students Build a Robot in 3 Days—and It Actually Worked!
articles.summary: A new MIT club called FIRSTxMIT built a robot named Timbot in just 72 hours. They showed it off at a huge high school robotics tournament in Washington, D.C. Even when it broke, they fixed it with an Ethernet cable, just like the high schoolers do!

articles.title: This Supergirl Movie Set Is a Secret Thank-You to a Comic Book Artist!
articles.summary: The new Supergirl movie built a huge, ruined city set named Evely on the planet Bilquis. That name is a tribute to Bilquis Evely, the artist who drew the Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow comic. The filmmakers wanted to honor her work in a big way.
